pages.title: Brass and Assembly
pages.text: **Brass** is the second tier of Create metal, made by mixing copper and zinc in a [#](2E5AAC)[heated basin](entry://create_basics/heat)[#](). Brass casings and parts open up [#](2E5AAC)[funnels with filters](entry://create_basics/item_logistics)[#](), tunnels, mechanical arms and more.

pages.title: Brass Ingot
pages.text: Copper plus zinc in a mixer over a heated burner. See [#](2E5AAC)[Processing](entry://create_basics/processing)[#]().

A **Precision Mechanism** is made by [#](7A3C9A)[sequenced assembly](entry://glossary/sequenced_assembly)[#](): one item goes through a chain of steps on a belt, repeated several times. It becomes an **incomplete** item in between. The steps use [#](2E5AAC)[deployers](entry://create_basics/deployer)[#]() and a press.

pages.title: Precision Mechanism
pages.text: Needed for many advanced machines in several mods. The recipe has a small chance of giving other items. Check [#](2E5AAC)[JEI](entry://start_here/tools)[#]() for the loop.

pages.title: Mechanical Crafter
pages.text: Arrange several in a [#](7A3C9A)[grid](entry://glossary/mechanical_crafting)[#]() and connect their paths to craft any recipe, even ones too big for the mixer. Fill every slot, then it crafts.

Mechanical crafters need [#](2E5AAC)[rotation](entry://create_basics/rotation)[#](). Use a [#](2E5AAC)[wrench](entry://create_basics/tools_wrench)[#]() to arrange paths, and slot covers to leave holes in the grid.\
\
The **Mechanical Crafter** works with packages too, see [#](2E5AAC)[Logistics](entry://create_basics/packages)[#]().
